descriptor: Meal planning app that does the shopping list

voice.summary: Talks like a friend with a spreadsheet and a good sense of humour: quick, practical and a little smug about being sorted. British spelling, prices in pounds, no food-blog gush.
dos: Pair every promise with a concrete example like one list
Use British words such as shopping list and courgettes
Keep sentences brisk with a light joke
donts: Never use diet or calorie language

taglines: Plan the week in a minute
boilerplate: Pantry Pilot is a meal-planning app that plans your week of dinners, builds a single shopping list and trims food waste along the way.

microcopy.success: Week planned. Your list is ready.
microcopy.error: We couldn't build that plan. Try again.
microcopy.empty: No meals planned yet. Tell us about your week.

logo.note: A shopping bag stands for the single list the app creates.
